source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion: Start at 150,000 mile inspection. 3. Review the test records and, if the most recent brake test is not within 40,000 miles, find the most recent brake test that took place within 3 months. 4. IF the failed test was performed on the current, same 6-axle trailer, go to step 5. 5. IF the current, same 6-axle trailer then passed a brake test, go to step 6. 6. IF the current trailer never passed or never completed a brake test, then it has not been maintained and you must fail the vehicle and document the reason in the Vehicle Condition Statement and Vehicle Condition Remarks sections. 1.
